contradicts_confirmation.identity_is_not_the_dominant_residue: Agreeing with the confirmation's OWN correction against the brief: degenerate-identity is 3 of 10 residues, not the dominant class. The instrumentation therefore does not report identity alone -- n_engine_raised, engine_raise_kinds and identity_measurable exist so that 'raised on every row' and 'answered nothing' are distinguishable from 'returned its input', and a dedicated control test proves a genuinely-wrong-but-live engine is NOT flagged identity even though it scores accuracy 0.0 exactly like a degenerate one does.
contradicts_confirmation.instrumentation_site: The confirmation proposed computing the fields in the `row.update` block. That site is reached BEFORE the loop's remaining engine consumers (`real_verify` on the reject path, `_goal_satisfiability_check` and planning on the accept path), so an instrumentation pass placed there would have had to invoke the engine again ahead of them -- which is precisely the statefulness hazard the confirmation itself flagged as 'THE ONE REAL RISK'. Its own mitigation ('run strictly AFTER every scoring call in the round') is not achievable at a single site: the round body has TEN `rounds.append(row)` exits. Reading the fields off the scoring pass the loop already runs achieves the same record with zero extra engine calls and makes the invariance structural.
contradicts_confirmation.one_field_beyond_the_recommendation: engine_source_sha256 was not in the confirmation's list. It is added because the confirmation named its ABSENCE as a limitation of its own evidence -- 'per-round emitted sources are never persisted, so the on-disk file cannot be tied to a specific round or cell'. `_read_engine_source` was previously called ONLY on the retention path (`if is_best`), i.e. never on the rounds that collapse. One already-exception-safe file read converts cell-level provenance into round-level.
contradicts_confirmation.p2_line_counts_differ_immaterially: The confirmation reported 1 of 12 substantive source lines reaching the refactor prompt; re-running the probe against the 1380-byte blob actually on disk at the CEGIS commit, with a >12-char filter, gives 2 of 28. Both hits are boilerplate from _REFACTOR_STRUCTURE_REMINDER_BEFORE ('def engine(grid, action, data):' and 'def is_level_complete(grid):'), whole-source-verbatim is False, and `refactor_prompt` contains no file read at all. The conclusion is unchanged and stronger: zero real source lines reach the prompt.

limitations: THIS IS NOT THE REPAIR. The diagnosed cause is that refactor_prompt(game, vr) never contains the engine it instructs the model to preserve and shows at most 5 FAILING cases and nothing that passed. That prompt is UNCHANGED here. This phase only makes the collapse legible in the record.

COVERAGE HOLE, STATED RATHER THAN PAPERED OVER: the engine-behaviour fields are recorded on the REJECT path, where the loop already computes a full scoring pass for free. An ACCEPTED round carries no such record and the fields are ABSENT -- which must be read as NOT MEASURED, never as zero. This covers 100% of the rounds in both shipped shards (every one of the 288 rounds either failed the proposer or was rejected at the held-out gate; not a single round ever cleared it), and a test asserts that fact so a future harness change that starts accepting rounds turns the suite red rather than silently under-covering.

DENOMINATOR MISMATCH, DISCLOSED IN THE DATA: `real_verify` scores the FULL corpus while `prefix_accuracy` is the prefix split only, so the identity fraction and the accuracy it explains are not computed over the same rows. `engine_behaviour_corpus` records this on every row. Re-scoring the prefix to match would mean invoking the engine again purely for a record, which is the one thing this instrumentation must not do. Note the full-corpus scoring here is ALSO defect (C)'s purity leak, which another agent owns and which this change deliberately does not touch.
OFFLINE IS NOT BEHAVIOURAL. Engine accuracy and engine identity are not plans, actions or levels. The trust gate still stands between them, and nothing here moves a level count.

NOT YET OBSERVED ON A LIVE RUN. Every measurement here is from the committed shards and from scripted-proposer tests. The instrumentation has not been exercised by a real LLM CEGIS run, because defect (B) means round 0 is 6.33x below its own matched control -- until that reproduces exp5764 within noise, nothing measured on this harness is interpretable, including anything these new fields would report.
question: DEFECT (A) INSTRUMENTATION. The CEGIS refactor step collapses world-model engines the induce step had already fit. `prefix_accuracy` proves THAT it collapses; nothing in the record said WHAT the emitted engine became, and that difference decides the repair. This phase adds the missing record. It is NOT the repair: no prompt, no acceptance decision and no default was changed.

sample_size.note: Clustered at the GAME level. The asymmetry holds independently in BOTH shards (9/49 vs 2/83, and 19/39 vs 2/77), i.e. across two different generators, and the 15 collapsed cells span 6 games -- not one game and not one generator.

parts.part_1_exact_reproduction: Re-derives the diagnosis from the real shipped shards: 28/88 induce (ceiling 1.0) vs 4/160 refactor (ceiling 0.125, and 0.125 is exactly 1/8), Fisher OR 18.2 p=1.0294417830164442e-10, 15 of 83 cells falling from a perfect 1.0 to 0.0 across 6 games, 30 of 30 post-perfect refactor rounds at 0.0, 117/117 snapshot accounting (rules out an import failure), and 40 null prefix_accuracy rows excluded with their reason rather than read as zeros.
parts.part_2_residue_classification: Behavioural, never syntactic, proven in BOTH directions: an engine whose source says `return grid` and is NOT identity, and an engine that IS identity without the literal ever appearing.
parts.part_3_trajectory_invariance: Zero extra engine calls; corpus not mutated; round rows gain ONLY the new keys; the instrumentation reads the loop's existing scoring pass; the counterexample handed to refactor_prompt is untouched.
parts.part_4_shard_whitelist: The new fields survive _summarize_cell, and an UNMEASURED round arrives as None rather than a fabricated zero.

trajectory_invariance.method: Ran ONE identical 3-round reinduction scenario against the instrumented code and against the pre-change code recovered from git HEAD, with the ENGINE ITSELF instrumented as the callee to count every invocation the whole loop makes.
trajectory_invariance.only_result_field_difference: engine_retention.store_path -- an artefact of deliberately using two separate tmp store directories so the two arms could not contaminate each other. Every substantive retention field (best_round, best_round_signal, best_round_true_changed_cells, enabled, restored, rounds_seen, selection_signal, signal_informative) is identical.

why_no_flag: Pure instrumentation: it only ADDS recorded fields and changes no control flow. The project's rule requires a default-OFF flag for BEHAVIOUR changes; for pure instrumentation it requires proof that no trajectory changes, which is supplied below by an executed both-directions comparison rather than asserted.
why_zero_extra_engine_calls_was_a_design: An engine may hold module-level state, so an instrumentation pass that invoked it even once more could change what a LATER consumer in the same round observes -- the counterexample handed to refactor, or the goal-satisfiability search. Riding the existing scoring loop makes the invariance STRUCTURAL rather than merely tested. The obvious implementation (a second pass over the transitions) would have doubled the count; mutation A' in the deletion proof confirms the suite catches exactly that.
